item.title: Effortless French Twist Claw Clip Updo on Bronde Hair
item.description: Master the effortless French twist claw clip updo on dimensional bronde hair with face-framing layers. This look features a seamless balayage and high-gloss glaze highlighting sun-kissed dimension. Styling tip: Twist upward, secure with a chic claw clip, and pull out soft tendrils. #TrendingHairstyles #HairColorIdeas #BalayageHair #HairInspo #SalonHair
